items.title: Help Wanted: 'Forward-Deployed' Humans for the A.I. Era
items.desc: Postings for "forward-deployed engineer" roles — staff who sit with clients to install and tune AI systems — are up twelvefold year-over-year on LinkedIn and 730% on Indeed, as enterprises buy AI they don't know how to set up. Economists quoted (Indeed Hiring Lab, Stanford's Nick Bloom) treat it as a rare AI-resilient job category, though Bloom argues much of the growth is title inflation on long-existing consulting work. [NYT Business, posted 2026-08-30]

items.title: Thievery or Innovation? The Music Industry Grapples With A.I.
items.desc: DealBook maps the economics of generative-AI music: Suno (roughly $1B raised, $5.4B valuation, 100M+ users) faces RIAA copyright litigation from Sony and Universal while simultaneously signing licensing deals with Warner and BMG, and Deezer reports AI-generated tracks are now about half its uploads. The piece also covers Rep. Greg Casar's proposed tax on AI tokens — levied on the higher of token volume or AI revenue and ramping up with job losses — and economists' objection that taxing a business input is less efficient than raising corporate taxes. [NYT DealBook, posted 2026-08-29]
